manualGuide.stackwalkWindows:
# Windows Manual Installation

1. Download the tool package:
   {0}

2. Extract the downloaded zip file.

3. Create `%USERPROFILE%\\.dumpstorm\\bin` and copy `minidump_stackwalk.exe` there.

4. Restart VS Code and try again.

PowerShell:
```powershell
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "{0}" -OutFile "breakpad.zip"
Expand-Archive -Path "breakpad.zip" -DestinationPath "breakpad-extract"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.dumpstorm\\bin"
Copy-Item "breakpad-extract\\*\\minidump_stackwalk.exe" "$env:USERPROFILE\\.dumpstorm\\bin\\" -Force
```
manualGuide.stackwalkUnix:

1. Download the tool package:
   {1}

3. Run `chmod +x ~/.dumpstorm/bin/minidump_stackwalk`.

4. Restart VS Code and try again.
manualGuide.llvmNmWindows:
# Manual LLVM-NM Installation for Windows

1. Download and extract `llvm-nm-windows-x64.zip` from the LLVM nightly releases.
2. Copy `llvm-nm.exe` to `%USERPROFILE%\\.dumpstorm\\bin\\`.
3. Restart VS Code.

PowerShell:
```powershell
$url = "https://github.com/appledragon/llvm-project/releases/download/nightly/llvm-nm-windows-x64.zip"
$zip = "$env:TEMP\\llvm-nm.zip"
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $zip
Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath "$env:TEMP\\llvm-nm" -Force
Copy-Item "$env:TEMP\\llvm-nm\\*\\llvm-nm.exe" "$env:USERPROFILE\\.dumpstorm\\bin\\" -Force
```

errors.heapCorruption: STATUS_HEAP_CORRUPTION - Heap corruption (often caused by use-after-free or double-free)

crash.nullInstructionPointer: Instruction pointer is NULL, possibly caused by null function pointer crash
crash.lowInstructionPointer: Instruction pointer is at a very low address, likely a null pointer dereference through an object offset or vtable call
crash.ipOnStack: Instruction pointer appears to be in the stack address range, possible stack buffer overflow leading to code execution on stack
crash.misalignedPC: ARM64 program counter (PC) is not 4-byte aligned, indicating corrupted PC value or invalid branch target
crash.lowStackPointer: Stack pointer abnormally low, possible stack overflow
crash.misalignedSP: ARM64 stack pointer is not 16-byte aligned, which violates the ARM64 ABI and will cause a crash
crash.nullLinkRegister: ARM64 link register (LR) is NULL, the crashed function was called through a null function pointer or LR was corrupted
crash.nullFramePointer: Frame pointer is NULL, stack frame chain is broken - may indicate stack corruption or invalid unwinding
crash.accessViolationReturn: Return value 0xC0000005 indicates access violation exception
crash.lowAddressValue: Low address value, possibly wild pointer or null pointer dereference
crash.guardPageHit: Guard page violation detected (STATUS_GUARD_PAGE_VIOLATION 0x80000001), may indicate stack probe failure or intentional guard page access
crash.misalignedPointer: Pointer value is oddly aligned, may indicate memory corruption or type confusion
crash.useAfterFree: Register contains freed memory fill pattern, strongly suggests use-after-free (UAF) bug. Common patterns: 0xDDDDDDDD (MSVC CRT freed heap), 0xFEEEFEEE (Windows HeapFree), 0xDEADBEEF (freed marker)
crash.uninitializedMemory: Register contains uninitialized memory fill pattern. Common patterns: 0xCDCDCDCD (uninitialized heap), 0xCCCCCCCC (uninitialized stack), 0xBAADF00D (LocalAlloc uninitialized)
